description: This is a PHP class file defining the Organization entity for the OrangeHRM application. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations to map class properties to database columns, representing organizational information such as name, contact details, and address.

classes.name: Organization
classes.description: Entity class representing the organization's general information, including name, tax ID, registration number, contact details, address, and notes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the organization.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the organization's unique identifier.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the organization's name.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the organization's name.

methods.name: getTaxId
methods.description: Returns the organization's tax ID.

methods.name: setTaxId
methods.description: Sets the organization's tax ID.

methods.name: getRegistrationNumber
methods.description: Returns the organization's registration number.

methods.name: setRegistrationNumber
methods.description: Sets the organization's registration number.

methods.name: getPhone
methods.description: Returns the organization's phone number.

methods.name: setPhone
methods.description: Sets the organization's phone number.

methods.name: getFax
methods.description: Returns the organization's fax number.

methods.name: setFax
methods.description: Sets the organization's fax number.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the organization's email address.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the organization's email address.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Returns the country where the organization is located.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Sets the country where the organization is located.

methods.name: getProvince
methods.description: Returns the province of the organization's location.

methods.name: setProvince
methods.description: Sets the province of the organization's location.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Returns the city of the organization's location.

methods.name: setCity
methods.description: Sets the city of the organization's location.

methods.name: getZipCode
methods.description: Returns the postal/zip code of the organization's location.

methods.name: setZipCode
methods.description: Sets the postal/zip code of the organization's location.

methods.name: getStreet1
methods.description: Returns the first line of the organization's street address.

methods.name: setStreet1
methods.description: Sets the first line of the organization's street address.

methods.name: getStreet2
methods.description: Returns the second line of the organization's street address.

methods.name: setStreet2
methods.description: Sets the second line of the organization's street address.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns any notes associated with the organization.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets notes for the organization.
